source: Native Settings screenshots from installed Project Tab Icons. Capture versions and dates are recorded per file.
crop: Appearance: automatic project tabs, shared presets, section navigation, compact Preview and Style. Git: compact Preview and Tab layout. Groups: shared presets, navigation, table header and Add group, ending before saved group rows. IDE titles, navigation tree and all working project names and paths are outside the crops.
demoData: Frontend, Backend and Tools, branches and line counts are built-in fixtures. git_with_icon and group_git are generic appearance preset names.
processing: Rectangular crops of native screenshot captures, converted from their supplied JPEG bytes to PNG. No UI pixels, labels or pointer were redrawn, blurred or retouched; the pointer was moved outside the crop through native UI before capture.
settings: Appearance and Git use the saved Custom appearance; Groups uses group_git. Settings were closed with Cancel after capture.
